༄༅/ /mai tri pa'i snyan brgyud las tshe dbang rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i bcud len bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mai tri pa'i snyan brgyud las tshe dbang rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i bcud len bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// tshe dbang rig 'dzin la mos rigs brgya'i dbang*// bde skyong bdud rtsi'i gzugs gsar byin rlabs kyis// brlabs par mdzad 'dis 'chi ba'i skabs dgag pa// mun la nyi ma shar 'drar phyag 'tshal lo// lugs 'di bslu med ras chung gis gzigs gtam// lho phyogs rigs ldan snyan du lhung ba'i tshul// kun spangs chos rje'i ljags kyi rtser bton pa// dril bzhin sgrogs 'di pad dkar 'chal bas so// tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa bsgrub par 'dod pa dag la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dus min 'chi ba blu ba la// yan lag kha ṭwāṃ dag dang sbyar// thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni// zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar// zhes gsungs pa'i cho ga la brten par bya ste/ bsgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa 'thems par song bas/ skar ma rgyal yod pa'i yar gyi ngo nas brtsams te grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba'i bar du'o// bcas ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba nas gsungs pa'i ka pā la mtshan ldan chang bzang po dang 'o ma cung zad bsres pa mngar gsum dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pas bkang*/ de la pra brtag pa ni/ g.yas nas bskor zhing mdun du 'khor// dpral ba'i ngos su bsdu ba yis// tshom bu lnga ni byung gyur na// rang la mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rtags// dbus su byung na shin tu mnyes// se sgrar ldan na sngags 'grub bo// tshom bu rnams ni phyogs su 'thor// sumbha ni sogs bgegs bskrad bya// zhag rnams mthar 'gro lbu ba 'thor// bkra mi shis pa'i rtags yin pas// bshags pa bya zhing srung 'khor bsgom// zhag dang lbu ba dbus su 'khrig /shin tu bzang bas dngos grub blangs// zhes pas so// der dar le brgan gyis dgab/ shar du zho dang 'o ma/ lhor mar khu/ nub tu bur sbrang*/ byang du chang*/ mtshams bzhir shing 'bru sna tshogs/ gru bzhi la bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ rtags brgyad/

rgyal srid sna bdun/ nye ba'i rin po che sna bdun bkod/ gzhi gru bzhi'i dbus su padma dmar po 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa'i khar mañdzi'i steng du thod pa'o// mtha' mchod pas bskor/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma'i sdong po 'dab ma brgyad byas pa/ lte bar nyi gdan la hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bsal/ tshe'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ de la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa tshe dpag tu med pa byi ru'i ri bo lta bu mtshan dpe'i dpyid kyis blta bas mdzes pa nyin mor byed pa 'bum phrag gi 'od zer can zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams du mas sgeg pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis klubs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ḥ snying gi phug tu nyi ma la hrīḥs bon gyis bskor ba de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus padma gar gyi dbang phyug chen pos nam mkha' gang ba dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa rnams kyis bum pas mngon par dbang bskur lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du lud pa zur phud kyi dbus su 'od dpag med du gyur/ oṃ tsakra saṃ wa ra padma ḍā ka arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widyā/ shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ badzra rā ga ra ti/ gang gi mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang*// 'chi bdag bdud kyi sde 'joms shing*// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// sbyin mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas sngags bzla ba'i dus sngags gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/

sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par sbyangs thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi rtse la lha mo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa nam mkha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten na tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang gzi brjid stobs mnga' thang thams cad de dag la bstim par bsam zhing*/ 'chi med byed pa'i dngos grub rdzas// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas byed rnams// aṅku sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe yi lha// mi 'khrugs rgyal po thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// a/ lho yi phyogs nas tshe yi lha// rin 'byung rgyal ba thams cad kyi// nub kyi phyogs nas tshe yi lha// snang mtha' rgyal ba thams cad kyi// byang gi phyogs nas tshe yi lha// don grub rgyal ba thams cad kyi// steng 'og mtshams nas tshe yi lha// gzi brjid rgyal po la sogs pa'i// zhes de dag gi sku gsung thugs ye shes bdud rtsi thams cad de la bstims pas mang por 'phel ba dang*/ lhag par ro bcud nus pa thams cad sbar bar bsam mo// de nas thun gyi mthar sngar gyi sngags kyi mjug tu/ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas 'bul/ dge ba bsngo/ de lta bus sgrub rdzas rnams 'phel ba dang 'od dang ldan par gyur na grub pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ratna siddhi a yu puṇya ka pā la siddhi bhrūṃ bhraṃ'u hūṃ hūm̐/ zhes bzlas rten 'brel snying po 'don pa sgrub sngags so// gnyis pa la/ lus 'chi med du byin gyis brlab pa/ ngag 'chi med du byin gyis brlab pa/ yid 'chi med du byin gyis brlab pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang lus tha mal gyi snang ba kho nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dang bcas pas/ rtsa yi zhing du rlung gis lam bstan te// khams kyi dwangs mas sems kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// ye shes 'od kyis mi shes mun bsal te// sku yi rdo rje thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsung gi rdo rje thob par byin gyis rlobs// thugs kyi rdo rje thob par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab/ rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/ lus stong ra/ 'og rlung 'then/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum dkar la dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen dang rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ de'i dbus su raṃ las nyi ma che zhing rgyas pa/ de'i steng du hrīḥdamar po me'i rang bzhin gsal btab/ lte ba'i 'khor lor gtum mo ye shes me// tshe dang 'od kyi snang ba cher rgyas pa// gyen du 'bar zhing drag tu bskul ba las// lus la 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes drag tu gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku dang dkyil 'khor lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi gtum mo'i me spros pa dang*/ rang gi hrīḥdam tshig pa'i me ro gcig tu 'dres pa las reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i me lcer 'bar bas rtsa gzugs 'chi bdag bdud bzhi'i rnam par yod pa bsregs pa dang*/ mdud pa thams cad dbral te lus thams cad gtum mo'i me'i rang bzhin 'ja' 'od du gyur par bsam pa dang bstun/ ka pā la spyi bor bzhag nas/ mchog tu dga' ba dga' ba che// lhan cig skyes dga' rtag dga' ba// padma rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku'i// dngos grub thams cad thob par shog/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ ā yu puṇye siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas/ spyi bo'i 'khor lor haṃ yig bde ba'i rgyun// tshe dang 'od kyi snang ba cher rgyas pas// thur du 'bab cing gyen du brtan pa yis// ngag la 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab lha tshogs bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung bung ba'i mchu lta bu 'phros te thod pa'i nang du song bas bdud rtsi drangs/ sna g.yon pa'i nang nas zhugs te spyi bor haṃ yig bdud rtsi 'dzag la khad pa dgu yod pa dang 'dres/ de dag dkar chil li li zhu nas spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba lus thams cad gang bar bsam

zhing steng rlung mnan nyer gcig gis bdud rtsi lhag ma lus par blta'o// de dus thod pa mgrin par bzhag sngar gyi tshig gi mthar ngag ces dang*/ sngags kyi mthar āḥzhes 'don pa bsgyur ro// gsum pa ni/ gsang skyil bcas/ sngon du/ snying ga'i 'khor lor zung 'jug ye shes dpyid// tshe dang 'od gyi snang ba cher rgyas pa// 'bar zhing 'dzag pa gnyis med ro mnyam pas// yid la 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes drag tu gsol ba btab/ rlung kha sbyar bum pa can 'dzin/ lte bar tshe'i bum pa'i khar padma'i sdong po la tshe dpag med dmar po yum can/ spyi bor bum pa'i khar padma'i sdong po la dkar po yum can/ de las dang po dmar po yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bum pa'i nang du song*/ de gang*/ chil gyis lud/ des mas rim gyis snying ga'i bar du gang*/ yang dkar po yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bum pa'i nang du song*/ de gang*/ chil gyis lud/ snying ga yan gang*/ snying ga'i 'khor lor dkar dmar 'thab pa'i bde ba la rtse gcig tu dbang shes kyi 'jug pa bsdus te mnyam par gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas/ 'jig rten khyim bdag rnams ni dpal brten nas// bil ba star ka bum pa bzang dang bcas// mdun du bdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar// bkra shis kun gyis deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces brjod/ tshe rdzas longs spyod/ bkra shis rdzas sna gnyis po gtad/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// skal ldan rigs kyi bu yang bdud bzhi las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub thob gyur cig/ sna bdun gnyis gtad/ ji ltar mi dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal ni// rgyal srid sna bdun tshogs dang ldan par ltar// skal ldan rigs kyi bu yang de lta bus// 'jig rten thams cad rjes su 'dzin gyur cig/

ces brjod la/ rab bam rgyun gyi nyams len la bsams pa tsam gyis 'grub bo// zhes rje btsun a wa dhū ti pa'i gsung gi gsang bas brgyan te/ padma dkar pos gnyal yangs pa can gyi chos 'khor rdo rje'i gdan du sbyar ba dge legs dam pas tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur cig gu/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wantī ye swā hā/// /
